div.span: A runner can stay alive while its polls for tasks keep timing out. At least six timed-out polls within 15 minutes while no job runs is a stall: the runner is stopped gracefully and restarted with back-off. A running job always wins (ADR 0006).

div.div: No graceful exit within the stop timeout (120 s) and no job running: the process tree is terminated (Action::Kill). A runner that exits again and again is a crash loop: five exits in ten minutes pause restarts for 30 minutes, notify, and a manual Start clears it. Silence is never a stall: an idle runner logs nothing for hours.
